about: Growth by repeated multiplying made countable: dots that multiply out of their parents step by step on the words, with the count and the multiplication written beneath: exponential growth, doubling, bacteria, compound interest, rumours spreading.

steps.about: how many times it multiplies (up to 9)

factor.about: what it multiplies by each step

start.about: how many there are at first

when.about: moments of each step; else one after another
